Priscilla Barielle - プリシラ・バーリエル
Birthday: September 7th

Personality: Priscilla's main trait is her overbearing arrogance and her confidence that events will work in her favour. Surprisingly, her bluster is far from empty. Priscilla has often faced dangerous situations, and is an adept and powerful fighter. This, combined with her preternatural luck (winning eight coinflips in a row, for example) and her great intuition, makes her a dangerous foe.

Her pride extends to her body. She is confident in her beauty, and she doesn't shy away from being seen naked or offering her body as a wager.

In spite of her insight, she is quite sheltered, often unaware of the aspects of common life, to the point of not knowing how an unpeeled apple looked.

She is a magic user, but doesn't use fire magic; instead she uses yang (light) magic, which mostly covers buffs.

She has the Divine Protection (a power randomly assigned at birth)of the Sun, which increases the effects of buffs and makes the user stronger during the day.

This version of Priscilla is taken after Arc 5, but before Arc 7. This will be explained in the following section. If you have more questions, message me in Discord and I will probably answer them.

Priscilla Barielle was born as Prisca Benedict, one of the 67 sons and daughters of Drizen Vollachia, the emperor of Vollachia, a country bordering with Lugnica.
Because Vollachia values strength above all else, the Imperial Selection Ceremony is a battle royale where the participants kill each other in order to suceed to the throne. Priscilla was a frontrunner despite her youth at the time, but ultimately lost, only surviving after being spared by the eventual winner, Vincent Vollachia.

She then entered a series of eight marriages that would all end in the death of her husbands, earning herself the moniker of the Bloody Bride. The last one of them was Leip Barielle, a ruthless and ambitious person who only married her due to being chosen as a Royal Selection candidate. Priscilla refused to be controlled by the old man, and Leip became ill and died after an encounter with Al, her servant. Thus, Priscilla became the ruler of the Barielle Barony, an event that would be celebrated by its inhabitants, as she brought prosperity to the lands.

Priscilla participates in the fight against the Witch Cult in Priestella, fighting personally against Sirius, the Archbishop of Wrath.

Then, after an assasination attempt by Vollachian assassins, she discovers than her birth nation is in danger, and she decides to get involved, sacrificing her life in the process.

case.name: Priscilla's sword
case.description: Priscilla produces a sword, seemingly out of nowhere. This will happen when she says her default After Stripping dialogue on stage 4, but you can also check if she is using her "sword" pose.

notes.note: I'm not entirely sure if Priscilla knows Al is from Japan? But I thought it would be fun if she entertained the idea of recruiting a knight from another dimension, unaware that she has one already.

At first I had written a set of interactions regarding Bowsette and Priscilla meeting... But then I realized it'd be far more organic to have them meet and play offscreen at least once, and carry some bad blood from it. As well as allowing me to discuss elements from each other's worlds without having to go through all the song of dance of introducing them first.
